summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a UK TR-1 major-holdings disclosure) on November 12, 2026, attaching a press release dated November 11, 2026. The filing discloses that The Capital Group Companies, Inc. crossed above the 18% voting threshold on November 9, 2026, reaching 18.007061% total voting rights, up from a prior position of 17.975584%. The stake comprises 287,811,457 common shares (13.36%) and 100,086,054 depositary receipts (4.65%), with no financial instruments. This is a passive ownership update, not a special situation; watch for further accumulation disclosures.
